topic: Better-Harness: An Open-Source Harness Engineering Platform

key_points: Official repo: 2,290 stars, 182 forks, MIT license, active (432+ commits, last push Sep 17, 2026)
Positioned as an open-source Harness Engineering platform for coding agents: 'define harnesses as code, run controlled experiments, inspect evidence, and compare outcomes'
Runs through the coding agent (Claude Code, Codex Desktop/CLI, Qoder Desktop/CLI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot CLI) via /better-harness slash command
Core evaluation model: 5-dimension Agent Work Loop (Task Understanding, Controlled Execution, Change Validation, Reliable Delivery, Learning Capture)
Three-layer openness: engineering practices, evaluation model, runnable implementation
Evidence-bound honesty: unobserved behavior stays explicit instead of unsupported scores
Emphasizes feedforward (AGENTS.md/specs/Skills) + feedback (linters/tests/Hooks) loop
Official Qoder docs: Better Harness reviewed 'Loop Engineering' assets (Rules, Skills, Hooks, MCP configs, Custom Agents, Plugins, Session Insights)
Finds strong/weak parts of the agent loop and can start a fix task with one click (Plan a fix -> Quest task)
Never applies fixes itself; every fix is a reviewable/rollback-able Quest task
Report covers pipeline scores, project usage heatmap, prioritized improvements, agent customization coverage, and flags 45+ min sessions for manual review
Positions harness engineering vs. model capability as the workflow around the diff
Third-party analysis: Better Harness reviews the engineering environment around a coding agent rather than grading one model response or code diff
Separates evidence gathering from final assessment: main analysis flow collects raw data, three independent read-only sub-agents interpret it
Three perspectives: Project Harness, Agent Customization, Session behavior
Surfaces operational weaknesses (unused rules, missing durable lesson-recording) rather than treating config file presence as proof of working process
Findings are evidence-bound and checkable on a later run
Curated harness engineering ecosystem list (3.5k stars) catalogs Better Harness among reference implementations
Defines harness engineering as scaffolding: context delivery, tool interfaces, planning artifacts, verification loops, memory, sandboxes
Names adjacent runtimes/alternatives: Pi (TypeScript agent harness), Codex (Rust), Deep Agents (LangGraph), OpenHands, Aider, Mini-SWE-Agent, Omnigent meta-harness
AGENTS.md convention (OpenAI-led, Linux Foundation-stewarded) emerged as the repo-side harness standard, adopted by 60,000+ repos
Category context: 'the model is the commodity, the harness is the moat'
Listings/aggregator: Better Harness evaluates coding-agent workflows and turns project + session evidence into prioritized, evidence-backed harness improvements
Supports multiple hosts with host-native (Canvas) or self-contained HTML+Markdown reports depending on host
Emphasizes that no universal entrypoint exists across hosts; setup differs per coding agent
Repair actions draft scoped fix plans for human review before applying

stats.fact: QoderAI/better-harness has ~2,290 GitHub stars and 182 forks as of 2026-09-17, up from 2,168 stars / 171 forks within days — fast-growing open-source project
Repository created 2026-07-21, MIT licensed, 432+ commits, ~2 months old but very active (last push 2026-09-17)
AGENTS.md convention (OpenAI-led, now Linux Foundation-stewarded) adopted by 60,000+ repos and most major agent CLIs (Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode)

Harness research corpus (arXiv 2609.00006) catalogs 11 production coding harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Mistral Vibe, OpenHands, Aider, Mini-SWE-Agent, Hermes, Pi, OpenCode, OpenClaw) — harness engineering is a formalized 2026 discipline
Skills (SKILL.md) edge out MCP in adoption across the 11-harness corpus (9/11 vs 8/11); ACP ships in six systems
Coding-agent harnesses 'turned from tool to platform' in H1 2026 — became importable SDKs, framework vendors shipped harnesses, marketplaces and enterprise governance appeared

angles: Review: What Better Harness actually does, how the 5-dimension Agent Work Loop works, and what 'evidence-bound' honesty means in practice
Position: Why improving the loop around an agent (harness) matters more than the final diff, and why it's an open-source platform vs. a proprietary tool
Comparison: Better Harness vs. other harness engineering runtimes/alternatives (Pi, OpenHands, Deep Agents, Codex hooks) in the broader 2026 harness-engineering boom
Hands-on: Installing /better-harness on Claude Code vs. Codex vs. Qoder/Cursor — host-specific setup because there's no universal entrypoint
Trend: The rise of harness engineering as a discipline (arXiv corpus, AGENTS.md, awesome lists) and where Qoder's open-source bet fits
Pitfalls/limits: No auto-fixes (all changes are reviewable Quest tasks), evidence gaps stay explicit, single successful task hides harness gaps that accumulate over time
